itens.trecho: Um herói de acção mais humano. Este filme começou uma notável franquia de filmes de acção que corre ao redor do detective John McClane, do Departamento de Polícia de Nova Iorque. Neste filme, ele tentará salvar a vida de um grupo de reféns presos num arranha-céu de Los Angeles. Dirigido por John McTiernan, o filme tem roteiro de Jeb Stuart e Steven E.

It has aged very well, with a lot of class, what a delightful franchise, many successors have tried to take it over, but few have been as successful, classic "High Temperature", cheesy Bruce Willis, and if it weren't for the paternal abandonment, well, it redeems itself, great effects, explosions, shootings, shattered glass, blood, a lovely dose of…

One seized tower block, one sweaty vest and one big set of action cojones. Based on ex cop Roderick Thorpe's 1979 novel Nothing Lasts Forever, Die Hard, directed by John McTiernan, changed the face of the action movie.
